reviews.review:
EDIT: Yes I like the game... But man the company can not make anything good anymore. The recent update, Scarlet Spear, is nothing more than a glorified mobile defence game with ♥♥♥♥♥♥ reward to  game play ratio (as usual). And so far the recent releases are ♥♥♥♥ after ♥♥♥♥ after ♥♥♥♥ after ♥♥♥♥. They really need to up their anti because for old players, this game is frigging boring. :END OF EDIT:

I like the game, but I think they way the company goes about it is trash. The reward system is a total joke, making it impossible for anyone to get something "rare" without having to do the same thing over and over and over several hundred times. The mechanics for certain "boss" fights are insane.

This game would be better if they changed up a few boss fights because they depend heavily on a certain setup (rhino, chroma, harrow, random normally) and the reward system too include a bonus for say every 10 completed bounties or certain boss kills, like 0.5% bonus too rare rewards until a cap.

Despite the negative connotations around being free to play warframe doesn't nag on you to spend and buy platinum ( The main trading currency) unlike other free to play games. At first the 24 hour building requirements seem like alot but the game gives you plenty to do in the mean time like gather resources in ACTUALLY FUN AND ENGAGING missions and socializing with other players. Speaking of which the warframe community is very freindly and willing to accept anyone new into the fold at the drop of a hat. There is also groups and clans for everybody, you like memes? We got plenty. You like being an edgelord? We got plenty of other edgelords for you to hang out with. You like being a space racist? I....I mean I guess you can do that too. 
Here's the TLDR: it's fun, it's free, and everybody is nice.
good game but ♥♥♥♥ this melee nerf
